reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes entry into a Polybius token offering, directs viewers to a link, and shows an interface for investing BTC. It promises immediate resale profit, dividends, and a bonus turning a $40 contribution into $50, while presenting the project as regulated despite describing its banking license as a future event.

citations.quote: I bought tokens.
you can sell on the market to get momentary profit, and you just save the tokens and receive dividends
the most profitable are the indefinite contracts.

opening.argument: The presentation uses qualification rather than certifying an outcome. The profit-sharing claim is expressly attributed to the company, not presented as independently verified fact: “According to the company's statement.” The speaker also describes resale as a possibility, saying “it is possible to sell with this profit,” rather than promising that every buyer will profit. The licensing language is prospective as well: the project will “receive a license from the bank,” which signals a project under development, not an assertion that a banking license already exists. Those qualifications support treating this as investment commentary about a proposed project, with the audience left to assess the company's documents and terms.

citations.quote: According to the company's statement
it is possible to sell with this profit
they will receive a license from the bank
read this document

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the possibility of resale and dividends as guarantees, although the presentation qualifies the profit-sharing statement as the company's own claim. “I bought tokens” shows personal participation, not that viewers were deceived or compelled to participate. The displayed bonus schedule likewise shows terms being described, but does not establish that a return was guaranteed or that any payout occurred.

citations.quote: According to the company's statement
I bought tokens.
20% profit is distributed among all tokens sold

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Attributing the claim to the company does not make repeating it neutral: the video still presents entry into the offering and explains how viewers can participate. The speaker's wording is not merely hypothetical; it says viewers can “sell on the market to get momentary profit” and “receive dividends.” The prospective license also confirms that regulated banking status was not established at the time shown.

here we select how to invest from the tool panel

opening.argument: The video's structure is a walkthrough and explanation of a project interface, rather than a bare demand for money. The speaker says he will go to the Polybius page and explain it “in more detail,” then identifies the internal office and walks through how to select an investment method. He also directs viewers toward the project's documents and roadmap for further reading. The sampled material shows a dashboard, project pages, team information, and a documents page listing a prospectus, whitepaper, terms, privacy policy, escrow arrangement, and business model. That evidence is consistent with educational commentary and operational demonstration about an ICO process.

citations.quote: let's go to the Polybius page and I will tell you in more detail
here we select how to invest from the tool panel
what is a road map to read all yourself

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening identifies an investment interface, but showing or explaining an interface is not itself proof of a scam. The video also presents project structure and supporting materials, including a documents page, rather than hiding the basis for evaluation. The quoted profit language is part of the project explanation and must be weighed alongside that walkthrough.

citations.quote: I will tell you in more detail
read this document

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A tutorial can still be promotional when it explains where to invest and emphasizes the financial upside. The walkthrough does not merely describe software: it shows an investment control with an amount field and an “INVEST” control, while the narration says viewers can obtain momentary profit or dividends. Documents and interface elements establish presentation, not that the offering is legitimate.

citations.quote: here we select how to invest from the tool panel
you can sell on the market to get momentary profit, and you just save the tokens and receive dividends

opening.argument: The material can be understood as ordinary promotion of a tokenized business project and a separate cloud-mining service. The description supplies links for a “Regulated bank project” and “Cloud mining,” while the narration distinguishes the token project from mining contracts and explains token pricing, currencies, and purchase mechanics. The supplied frames show an investment form and account dashboard, but do not show a completed deposit, payout, credential request, recruitment chain, or downline income. The existence of a purchase offer and promotional bonus is not by itself evidence of a scam mechanism; the supplied record shows a product and its advertised terms, not a demonstrated fraudulent outcome.

citations.quote: 1. Regulated bank project - https://polybius.io 2. Cloud mining - https://hashflare.io/r/6442CE11.
what options are available in one click
The payment transfer takes up to seven days.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening does not require a completed payout to establish promotional investment content. The video explicitly describes token purchase, resale profit, and dividends, and the screen includes an investment control and bonus schedule. Calling the links ordinary services does not answer why viewers are told that holding tokens can produce company profits or why the offering is presented as an opportunity to invest.

citations.quote: I bought tokens.
you can sell on the market to get momentary profit, and you just save the tokens and receive dividends

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing completed payout does not neutralize the solicitation: scam promotion can occur before a transaction finishes. The description itself directs viewers to the project and mining links, while the video explains that tokens may be sold for immediate profit or held for dividends. The investment interface and bonus schedule are evidence of an offered financial transaction, not merely an ordinary retail purchase.
